name: Codex CLI
description: Run Codex on your hosted Subconscious model with a temporary provider catalog and compaction hooks.

install.note: Below minimum_version Codex ignores multi_agent_version and runs without subagents. subc warns and does not block.

help.behavior: Launches Codex with a temporary Subconscious provider catalog. Compaction hooks are merged into ~/.codex/hooks.json on first launch and removed with subc codex uninstall; Codex will not run them until you trust them with /hooks once.
options: Install the Subconscious compaction hooks (then trust with /hooks)
Remove only the Subconscious Codex hooks
Override the profile model for this launch

prerequisites.note: Without jq a launch skips the hooks with a warning, and subc codex install fails.
Without curl the hook exits without reporting.

launch.note: Each launch merges the compaction hooks into ~/.codex/hooks.json when they are missing or stale (best effort). The root -c overrides also apply to codex exec.

inputs.name: CODEX_API_KEY
inputs.label: Codex API key
inputs.description: Codex-specific credential override; blank uses API_KEY.

inputs.name: CODEX_CONTEXT_WINDOW
inputs.label: Context window
inputs.description: Context window written into the Codex model catalog.

inputs.name: CODEX_MAX_CONTEXT_WINDOW
inputs.label: Maximum context window
inputs.description: Maximum context window written into the Codex catalog.

inputs.name: CODEX_AUTO_COMPACT_TOKEN_LIMIT
inputs.label: Auto-compact token limit
inputs.description: Codex token threshold that triggers automatic compaction.

inputs.name: CODEX_REASONING_EFFORT
inputs.help: Use none, low, medium, high, or max
inputs.label: Reasoning effort

inputs.name: CODEX_EXTERNAL_TOOLS
inputs.help: Enable Codex apps/plugins for this launch
inputs.label: External tools
inputs.description: Enable Codex apps/plugins; may exceed the gateway tool limit.

inputs.name: CODEX_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
inputs.help: Allow a longer silent think before timing out
inputs.label: Stream idle timeout (ms)
inputs.description: How long Codex waits on a silent stream before giving up. Needs to exceed the longest think the model will take.
inputs.note: The marathon models at max reasoning effort routinely think for longer than five minutes without emitting a token, and a subagent's turn is one uninterrupted think, so the old 300s ceiling cut off work that was still running.

inputs.name: CODEX_MULTI_AGENT_VERSION
inputs.label: Codex multi-agent version
inputs.description: Which subagent implementation Codex offers: v2 gives the collaboration tools. Leave empty to turn subagents off entirely.
inputs.note: The catalog field selects which implementation Codex offers, not whether it offers one: v2 gives the collaboration namespace, "v1" registers nothing, and an empty field falls back to multi_agent_v1. Only agents.enabled=false turns subagents off, so an empty value sets both.

inputs.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_REASONING_EFFORT
inputs.help: Effort for subagents, separate from the parent
inputs.label: Subagent reasoning effort
inputs.description: Effort for Codex subagents, set separately from the parent: a marathon model at max thinks for minutes without emitting a token, and a subagent turn is one uninterrupted think, so inheriting max makes every delegated subtask look like a hang.
inputs.note: Empty inherits Codex's default. Low rather than medium: the gateway rounds medium up to high for GLM, and at high a subagent handed an open-ended task keeps deliberating without ever writing the closing </think>, so the turn comes back as prose with no tool call and the agent reports success having produced no files. Measured against the worker on one broad task: low closed and called a tool in ~1.5k characters, high ran past 76k and was still going.

inputs.name: MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS
inputs.help: Subagents allowed to run at once
inputs.note: A ceiling, not a default: Codex spawns a subagent only when asked. Codex documents no nesting-depth limit, so concurrency is the only lever. Four is a floor rather than a considered limit: Codex's own default is three, and exceeding either fails the spawn outright rather than queueing it.

env.name: SUBCONSCIOUS_GATEWAY_URL
env.description: Gateway origin for the hook environment.

config.name: model_catalog_json
config.description: Temporary model catalog written by the runbook; see the file entry.

config.name: web_search
config.description: Keeps hosted web search, which the gateway cannot run, out of requests.

config.name: features.apps
config.description: Keeps the request under the gateway's 128-tool limit.
config.note: The gateway accepts at most 128 tools per request, and Codex apps and installed plugins can exceed that before any core coding tools are added.

config.name: features.plugins
config.description: Keeps the request under the gateway's 128-tool limit.

config.name: apps._default.enabled
config.description: Keeps the request under the gateway's 128-tool limit.

config.name: agents.enabled
config.note: Clearing the catalog field alone only downgrades Codex to multi-agent v1, whose tools this gateway has never been exercised against.

config.description: One entry per catalog model, written by the runbook. Image input is advertised only for vision models. Left in the temp directory: the runbook execs codex, so its exit trap never runs.
PreCompact and PostCompact entries are merged in; other entries are kept.
SUBCONSCIOUS_GATEWAY_URL and SUBCONSCIOUS_API_KEY for the hook (mode 600).
Hook fire log, one file per session.

on.name: auto_compact_token_limit
on.note: Auto-compaction is on through the catalog threshold.

off.note: The runbook has no off switch. Setting a threshold above context_window may work, but that is not confirmed.

threshold.name: auto_compact_token_limit
threshold.note: Written per model into model_catalog_json. subc does not use the model_auto_compact_token_limit config key.

mcp.note: subc adds no MCP servers. User MCP config in ~/.codex/config.toml is left alone.

headers.name: x-subconscious-client
headers.note: Model requests carry no subc-set header.

hooks.note: Per install.sh help: Codex runs hooks only once trusted with /hooks, and codex exec needs --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust, which subc never passes.
